                EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY’S MOTION TO ADOPT
                    PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE AND AGREEMENT
                  TO SUSPEND THE REQUESTED EFFECTIVE DATE

       El Paso Electric Company (“EPE”) files this response to SOAH Order No. 1 and submits

this motion to adopt a procedural schedule.

                I.     Procedural Schedule and Date for Hearing on the Merits

       Pursuant to SOAH Order No. 1, EPE conferred with all parties regarding a proposed

procedural schedule and dates for a hearing. EPE was unable to receive affirmative agreement of

all parties to a schedule. EPE is authorized to present the following as a procedural schedule and

date for the hearing on the merits in this proceeding that is agreed to by City of El Paso, Texas

Industrial Energy Consumers, Office of Public Utility Counsel, and Commission Staff. However,

EPE has been unable to verify the position of New Horizon Devco, LLC, and Southwest Power

Connection, LLC regarding this schedule.

      Discovery Agreements
                Drafts of testimony and emails that include drafts of testimony as attachments are
                 not discoverable.
                Responses to discovery on EPE direct will be due within 10 calendar days of

                                                  2

               days.
              Responses to discovery on rebuttal and cross-rebuttal will be due in 5 calendar
               days.
              Parties also agree to service by email except that EPE may serve discovery
               responses by use of secure workspace.
              Workpapers for all testimony are due in native format one day after the testimony
               is filed
              Cross-examination exhibits are due by 7:00 pm the day before the intended use of
               the exhibit during cross-examination of a witness.

                     II.    Agreement to Suspend Proposed Effective Date

       On April 7, 2026, EPE filed its application for a new tariff, Schedule No. 27 – High Load

Factor Large Power Service, with a proposed effective date of May 12, 2026. The City Council of

the City of El Paso, as a regulatory authority with original jurisdiction over EPE’s rates within the

city’s municipal limits, suspended the proposed effective date for the full 90-day statutory period.

Consistent with the procedural schedule proposed above, EPE agrees that the proposed effective

date of Schedule No. 27 is extended until the issuance of a final Commission order in this docket,

in both the areas subject municipal original jurisdiction, and the areas subject to the Commission’s

original jurisdiction, and the parties agree that Schedule No. 27 will not be deemed approved by

operation of law under PURA § 36.108(b) before a final order.

                                        III.    Conclusion

   EPE requests that the ALJ enter an order adopting the above procedural schedule for this

proceeding and issue an order suspending the effective date of Schedule No. 27 until a final order

is issued by the Commission.

       EPE requests that the above procedural schedule be adopted for this.
